status: protocol recorded before new four-chain execution; no new JAGS run launched by this task

initial_gate.target: Chapter2 floor item-level posterior on the same fixed N500/J60 generated dataset, data seed301
initial_gate.model: simulation/jags_replication.R at frozen production revision; reconstruct and hash data once, reuse unchanged across chains
initial_gate.initialization: Add explicit, independently specified valid overdispersed starts for mu,beta0,beta1,ta,tc and record them; fix generated data, b and moderator values. Do not change data seed between chains. Existing RNG-only wrapper needs this small implementation before dispatch.
initial_gate.adaptation_rule: Record whether adaptation completes; if incomplete, flag nonvalid diagnostic run. Do not discard an unfavorable chain or replace its seed.

diagnostics_and_acceptance.implementation: Use verified posterior package implementation (version and source hash pinned at execution) or independently validate equivalent code; coda effectiveSize alone is insufficient.
diagnostics_and_acceptance.manual: Inspect rank plots and traces for every monitored global parameter; report worst parameter/chain, adaptation messages and chain-specific summaries. Finite or passing diagnostics do not prove convergence.
diagnostics_and_acceptance.interval_precision: Compute 2.5% and97.5% quantile MCSE and tail ESS separately. Preserve source HPD summaries and evaluate HPD endpoint sensitivity by chain and equal-length splits; rank diagnostics for means do not certify HPD precision. If interval-edge noise affects zero-exclusion conclusions, withhold detection classification.
diagnostics_and_acceptance.threshold_scope: Operational diagnostic thresholds chosen in advance for this follow-up, not scientific agreement/equivalence margins. Not asserted as a theorem guaranteeing convergence.

resource_and_stopping.initial_fixed_batch: All4 chains at stated source length; no early stopping based on sign, significance, numerical match, favorable ordering or interim ESS.
resource_and_stopping.parallelism: Chapter6production has priority. Run at most1JAGS chain while at most3OpenMx workers are active, or wait for a bounded OpenMx batch boundary. Never exceed cgroup4CPU quota. Measure JAGS RSS first and require memory headroom before concurrency.
resource_and_stopping.timeout_or_failure: Preserve failed chain logs, exact arguments/RNG/init state and elapsed time; denominator remains4 requested. Do not count partial chains as full source-length evidence or silently refill failures.
resource_and_stopping.if_gate_fails: Report unresolved. Prespecify a later fixed longer batch or validated reparameterization after diagnosis; preserve failed gate. No automatic indefinite extension.
resource_and_stopping.checkpoint: Freeze script/model/runtime/data hashes and all RNG/init records before dispatch; append chain files atomically; continuation must restore actual sampler state or be labelled a fresh chain, not concatenated as if uninterrupted.

later_stages: Only after four-chain gate, perform independent original-centred representation chains on the same fixed data, retaining separate diagnostics and shared-engine/model limitations.

For Chapter2power/recovery, keep100 fixed generated datasets per condition and both floor/ceiling/symmetric arms. Record all failed/nonvalid datasets and report intended,attempted,valid counts; no stopping when desired power/significance is reached.

Before Chapter5production, repeat timing and mixing diagnostics at representative N/J using prespecified small resource batches. The N8000condition estimate of213worker-days forbids an automatic unbounded launch; validated acceleration must preserve the target posterior.

primary_method_sources.title: Vehtari et al. (2021), Rank-normalization, folding, and localization
primary_method_sources.use: Motivation for rank-normalized/folded diagnostics and localized efficiency, not a claim that finite diagnostics prove convergence.
Rhat is max of rank-normalized split and folded-split; nonfinite/constant chains returnNA.
Bulk ESS uses rank-normalized split chains.
Tail ESS is min of5%and95%quantile ESS.

existing_baseline_limit: The current two-representation Rhat and ESS are preserved; they are not four independently initialized chains and do not establish the production grid.
